signals.headline: U.S. and Iran resume attacks. And, Fauci to face Senate questions on COVID pandemic
signals.summary: Fighting between the U.S. and Iran resumed after Iran launched missiles at U.S. forces in the Middle East yesterday, just before 6 p.m. ET, according to U.S. Central Command.
keyTakeaways: U.S. and Saudi forces responded with attacks on Iranian-backed militias in Iraq, marking a rare show of force from Saudi Arabia in this conflict.
Israel wants to continue fighting to address security threats from Iran and Iran-backed Hezbollah in Lebanon.
Dr. Anthony Fauci is set to testify today before a Senate committee as part of ongoing investigations into the origins of COVID-19.
signals.whyItMatters: The escalation in violence happened on the same day President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and Ukrainian leader Zelenskyy at the White House.

ja.headline: 米・イラン間の緊張が再燃、ファウチ博士は上院で証言へ
ja.summary: 米中央軍によると、現地時間昨日午後6時前、イランが中東の米軍部隊に向けてミサイルを発射し、米国とイランの間で再び戦闘が始まった。
keyTakeaways: 米軍とサウジアラビア軍はイラク国内のイラン系民兵組織への攻撃で応じた。サウジがこの紛争に直接関与するのは異例のことだ。
イスラエルはイランおよびレバノンのヒズボラが及ぼす安全保障上の脅威に対処するため、戦闘継続の意向を示している。
アンソニー・ファウチ博士は本日、新型コロナウイルスの起源をめぐる調査の一環として上院委員会で証言する予定だ。
ja.whyItMatters: この緊張の高まりは、トランプ大統領がホワイトハウスでイスラエルのネタニヤフ首相とウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領と会談した当日に起きた。

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: I'm seeing reports about fighting between the U.S. and Iran. What happened?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Iran launched missiles at U.S. forces in the Middle East yesterday, just before six p.m. Eastern time. That's according to U.S. Central Command.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: And how did the U.S. respond?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: U.S. and Saudi forces responded with attacks on Iranian-backed militias in Iraq. It's actually a rare show of force from Saudi Arabia in this conflict.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: What does Israel want in all of this?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Israel wants to continue fighting to address security threats from Iran and Iran-backed Hezbollah in Lebanon.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: The timing seems notable. Was anything else happening yesterday?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Yes. This all happened on the same day President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and Ukrainian leader Zelenskyy at the White House.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: And I saw something about Dr. Fauci testifying today?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Right. He's set to testify before a Senate committee as part of ongoing investigations into the origins of COVID-19.

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 昨日の夕方、イランが中東にいるアメリカ軍に向けてミサイルを発射しました。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: これを受けて、アメリカとサウジアラビアはイラク国内の民兵組織を攻撃しています。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: サウジアラビアがこの紛争で直接攻撃に加わるのは珍しいことです。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 一方イスラエルは、イランとレバノンのヒズボラへの対応を続ける構えを示しています。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: この動きは、トランプ大統領がネタニヤフ首相やゼレンスキー大統領と会談した日に起きました。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 別の話題として、ファウチ博士が今日、上院で証言します。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 新型コロナウイルスがどこから来たのかを巡る調査の一環です。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 中東の緊張と国内の検証が、同時に動いている朝です。

signals.headline: Some people's chats with Claude AI found to be publicly available online
signals.summary: Hundreds of user conversations with Anthropic's popular artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot Claude were found to have been available to essentially anyone online.
keyTakeaways: Links to the chats, some of which included personal and work information, would show up if a user of a search engine like Google used a site-specific search term.
The searches showed Claude chats for which a user had decided to "share" a link had been saved by search engines like Google, leaving them accessible to the broader public.
A spokeswoman for Anthropic said that Claude users maintained control over if and when to share conversations they had with the chatbot.
signals.whyItMatters: The share option within Claude tells a user that "anyone with the link" may view the contents of that link, but does not explicitly state that the link may end up in Google and search results.

ja.headline: Claudeとのチャットが検索で誰でも閲覧可能な状態に
ja.summary: AnthropicのAIチャットボット「Claude」におけるユーザーとの会話が、数百件にわたってオンライン上で事実上誰でも閲覧できる状態にあったことが明らかになった。
keyTakeaways: 個人情報や業務上のやり取りを含む会話へのリンクが、Googleなどで特定の検索を行うと表示される状態だった。
ユーザーが「共有」を選んだチャットのリンクが検索エンジンに保存され、広く一般に公開される形になっていた。
Anthropicの広報担当者は、会話を共有するかどうかはユーザー自身が管理していると説明した。
ja.whyItMatters: Claudeの共有機能には「リンクを持つ誰もが閲覧できる」と記されているが、そのリンクが検索結果に表示される可能性については明示されていない。

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: I saw something about Claude AI chats being found online. What happened exactly?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Hundreds of conversations people had with Claude ended up publicly accessible. If you searched Google with specific terms, you could find links to these chats.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Wait, how did private conversations end up on Google?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: They weren't exactly private. Users had clicked a 'share' button to create a link. Those shared links then got saved by search engines, making them discoverable by anyone.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So people shared them without realizing they'd be searchable?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: That seems to be the issue. Claude tells users that 'anyone with the link' can view it, but doesn't explicitly mention the link might show up in Google results.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: What kind of information was in these chats?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Some included personal and work information. The concern is people may have thought they were just sharing with specific individuals, not the entire internet.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: What's Anthropic saying about this?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: A spokeswoman said users maintain control over whether to share conversations. The sharing is intentional, but the visibility in search results caught people off guard.

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: AnthropicのAIチャットボット、Claudeで起きた出来事です。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: ユーザーが共有したはずの会話が、数百件も検索エンジンに拾われていました。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 個人的な内容や仕事の話も含まれていたといいます。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: Googleで特定の言葉を検索すると、これらのリンクが表示される状態でした。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 共有機能には「リンクを持つ人が見られる」とあるものの、検索結果に載る可能性は書かれていません。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: Anthropicは、共有の判断はユーザーに委ねていると説明しています。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: AIとのやり取りを共有するとき、どこまで広がるかを知っておく必要がありそうです。

signals.headline: As Spain battles wildfires, its politicians battle over climate change's role
signals.summary: Crews are still battling wildfires that broke out last week and have burned nearly 200,000 acres across Spain.
keyTakeaways: SACHA PFEIFFER, HOST: In Spain, crews are still battling fires that broke out last week and have devastated nearly 200,000 acres across the country.
Now Spain is bracing itself even more as temperatures are again set to rise to more than 100 degrees starting tomorrow, as NPR's Miguel Macias reports.
MIGUEL MACIAS, BYLINE: It's always been very hot in Spain in the summer.
signals.whyItMatters: The country is bracing for another round of extreme heat, with temperatures expected to top 100 degrees Fahrenheit starting Wednesday.

ja.headline: 山火事が続くスペイン、気候変動をめぐり政界も揺れる
ja.summary: 先週発生した山火事はいまだ収束せず、スペイン全土でおよそ八万ヘクタールが焼失した。消火活動が続くなか、政治家たちは気候変動との関連をめぐって論戦を繰り広げている。
keyTakeaways: 先週から続く山火事により、スペイン全土でおよそ八万ヘクタールが焼き尽くされた。
明日からは再び気温が摂氏三十八度を超える見込みで、当局はさらなる警戒を呼びかけている。
スペインの夏の酷暑は以前からのことだが、その深刻さは年々増している。
ja.whyItMatters: 再び極端な高温が迫るなか、スペインは厳しい試練に直面しようとしている。

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: I saw Spain is dealing with major wildfires right now. How bad is it?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: It's serious. Fires that started last week have burned nearly 200,000 acres across the country, and crews are still working to contain them.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: That's a huge area. Is there any relief coming?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Unfortunately, the opposite. Spain is bracing for another round of extreme heat starting Wednesday, with temperatures expected to go above 100 degrees.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So the conditions that helped fuel these fires are coming back?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Exactly. And it's worth noting that while Spain has always had hot summers, the intensity and frequency of these heat waves is what's raising concerns.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Is there debate in Spain about what's driving this?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Yes. Politicians there are actually battling over climate change's role in these wildfires, even as the fires themselves continue burning.

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: スペインでは先週から続く山火事が、いまも各地で燃え広がっています。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 焼失した面積はすでに八万ヘクタールに達しました。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 消火活動が続くなか、明日からは再び気温が摂氏三十八度を超える予報が出ています。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: スペインの夏はもともと暑いのですが、近年その厳しさが増しているのは確かです。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: こうした状況のなかで、政治家たちは気候変動との関わりをめぐって意見を戦わせています。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 暑さと火災が重なる日々が、この国にとって新たな試練となっています。

signals.headline: Datacentre projects could face fees for grid access to ease connection queue, Ofgem says
signals.summary: Datacentre projects in Britain will be forced to put down significant upfront fees to secure an energy connection under proposals to ease an electricity grid logjam.
keyTakeaways: Ofgem, the sector watchdog, said there were 315 datacentres currently queueing to connect up, representing 73GW of demand.
This will be demanded when a project receives a connection offer and returned when the datacentre is switched on.
Ofgem is proposing that datacentre providers, who include companies such as Amazon and Microsoft, put down pledges of £350m to reserve 500MW of grid capacity.
signals.whyItMatters: Under the energy regulator for Great Britain’s proposals to thin out speculative schemes, projects will be required to lodge significant upfront fees or financial security via letters of credit, bonds or cash deposits.

ja.headline: データセンターの系統接続に前払い費用、英規制当局が提案
ja.summary: 英国のエネルギー規制当局オフジェムは、電力系統への接続待ちが深刻化するなか、データセンター事業者に対して接続枠を確保するための多額の前払い費用を義務付ける案を示した。
keyTakeaways: 現在315件のデータセンターが接続を待機しており、その需要は合計73GWに上る
費用は接続オファーの受領時に徴収され、施設の稼働開始後に返還される
アマゾンやマイクロソフトなどの事業者が対象で、500MWの容量確保に3億5000万ポンドの拠出が求められる
ja.whyItMatters: 投機的な計画を排除し系統接続の混雑を緩和するため、オフジェムは信用状・債券・現金預託などによる財務的担保の提供を事業者に求める方針だ。

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: I saw something about datacentres having to pay fees just to connect to the electricity grid. What's going on there?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Britain's energy regulator, Ofgem, is proposing that datacentre projects put down significant upfront fees to reserve grid capacity. The idea is to ease a huge backlog.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: How big is this backlog?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: There are currently 315 datacentres queueing to connect, representing 73 gigawatts of demand. That's a lot of projects waiting in line.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So what exactly would these fees look like?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Ofgem is proposing that providers put down pledges of £350 million to reserve 500 megawatts of grid capacity. The money would be returned when the datacentre actually switches on.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Why make them pay upfront like that?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: The regulator wants to thin out speculative schemes. Some projects might be reserving grid space without serious plans to build, and this requirement helps ensure only committed projects move forward.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Who are we talking about here? Big tech companies?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Yes, the providers include companies like Amazon and Microsoft. They can put down the fees as cash deposits, letters of credit, or bonds.

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: イギリスでは今、データセンターが電力網につなぐための順番待ちが深刻になっています。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: エネルギー規制当局のオフジェムによると、接続を待つ施設は315件、必要な電力は合わせて73ギガワットに達しています。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: これは投機的な計画が枠を押さえたまま放置されているためです。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: そこでオフジェムは、接続枠を確保したい事業者に多額の前払い費用を求める案を示しました。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 例えば500メガワットの枠には3億5000万ポンドが必要で、施設が実際に動き出せば返還されます。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: AmazonやMicrosoftといった大手も対象です。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 本気の計画だけを残し、待ち行列を整理する狙いがあります。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: データセンターの急増は電力網の余力を問い直す局面を迎えています。

signals.headline: How to see July's Buck Moon light up the night sky
signals.summary: The July full Moon, also known as the Buck Moon, will light up the night sky across the UK on Wednesday.
keyTakeaways: The second of three full Moons this summer, it is set to peak at 15:36 BST on 29 July.
The exact moment of its maximum fullness will be missed across the UK as the Moon will be just below the horizon.
Why is it called the Buck Moon?
signals.whyItMatters: Across north-west England and Wales the remnants of a cold weather front might obscure the sky, but very little rain is expected and the cloud could break.

ja.headline: 7月の満月「バックムーン」、今夜の夜空を照らす
ja.summary: 7月の満月、通称「バックムーン」が水曜日の夜、英国の空に浮かぶ。夏の夜を静かに彩る、季節の便りだ。
keyTakeaways: 今夏3度の満月のうち2度目。最大の満月は7月29日15時36分（英国夏時間）に訪れる
満月の瞬間、月は地平線の下にあるため、英国では肉眼で捉えることができない
「バックムーン」という名の由来は、この時期に雄鹿の角が伸びることにちなむ
ja.whyItMatters: イングランド北西部とウェールズでは寒冷前線の影響で雲が広がる恐れがあるが、雨はほとんど見込まれず、雲の切れ間から月を望める可能性もある。

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So there's a full Moon coming up this week?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Yes, on Wednesday. It's called the Buck Moon, and it's the second of three full Moons this summer.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Buck Moon? That's an interesting name.

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: It is. The name comes from traditional naming, though the story doesn't explain exactly why it's called that.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: When's the best time to see it?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: It peaks at 15:36 BST on the 29th, but that's when the Moon will be just below the horizon in the UK. So you'll want to look after sunset when it rises.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: Will the weather cooperate?

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Mostly, yes. There might be some cloud across north-west England and Wales from a cold front, but very little rain is expected and the cloud could break up.

captions.speaker: listener
captions.text: So it should still be visible for most people.

captions.speaker: explainer
captions.text: Exactly. It's worth looking up Wednesday evening to catch it lighting up the night sky.

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 水曜日の夜、イギリスでは7月の満月が空に昇ります。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: この満月は「バックムーン」と呼ばれています。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 名前の由来は、この時期に雄鹿の角が伸びることです。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 満月の瞬間は29日の午後3時36分ですが、その時刻には月が地平線の下にあります。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: イギリスでは最も丸い瞬間を直接見ることはできません。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: それでも夜になれば、ほぼ満月の姿を楽しめます。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 北西部やウェールズでは雲が出る可能性がありますが、雨の心配は少ないようです。

captions.speaker: narrator
captions.text: 雲の切れ間から、夏の夜空に浮かぶ月を眺められるかもしれません。
